final: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge, f.feerate, f.rebrate, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) as net_fee FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), group_avgs AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(net_fee) as group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM filtered_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_avgs AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) as side_avg_net_fee FROM group_avgs GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT ga.orderslink, ga.dealedge, ga.group_avg_net_fee, ga.record_count, (ga.group_avg_net_fee - sa.side_avg_net_fee) as difference FROM group_avgs ga JOIN side_avgs sa ON ga.dealedge = sa.dealedge WHERE ga.group_avg_net_fee > sa.side_avg_net_fee ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
